slides.headline: ChatGPT talks like a person. *GPT* is the engine under it.
subtitle: What GPT means, in plain words.
No tech background needed.
slides.narration: Let's understand and learn GPT in 1 min. You may have used a chatbot like ChatGPT. But what does the GPT part mean? Let's find out in simple words.

slides.heading: GPT is three *words* in one name
body: G: Generative. It creates new text.
P: Pre-trained. It learned from huge amounts of text first.
T: Transformer. The design that links words together.
slides.narration: GPT stands for Generative Pre-trained Transformer. Generative means it creates new text. Pre-trained means it first learned from huge piles of books. Transformer is the design that lets it see how words connect.

slides.heading: At heart, it is a *word guesser*
body: You type: "The cat sat on the"
It picks the likeliest next word: "mat".
Then it adds that word and guesses again.
slides.narration: At its heart, GPT is a word guesser. You type, the cat sat on the. It picks the most likely next word, which is mat. Then it guesses again, and again, until the answer is complete.

slides.heading: It links each word to the *right* one
body: Older tools read one word after another, and forget.
A transformer looks at all the words together.
slides.narration: Older tools read one word after another, so they forget the start of a long sentence. A transformer looks at all the words together. Take this sentence: the dog chased the ball because it was fast. The transformer links it back to dog, not ball.

slides.heading: ChatGPT is *GPT* in a chat window
body: ChatGPT is the app you type into.
GPT is the engine that writes each reply.
slides.narration: So what is the difference? GPT is the engine. ChatGPT is the app you type into, built on top of that engine. The engine writes each reply one word at a time.

slides.heading: It can be *confidently* wrong
body: It writes what sounds right, which is not always true.
For facts that matter, check a trusted source.
slides.narration: GPT writes what sounds right, and that is not always the same as what is true. It can make up facts with full confidence. So for anything important, check a trusted source.

slides.headline: GPT is a word guesser, very well trained.
slides.cta: Follow vivektraces for the next one.
slides.narration: That is GPT in short: a transformer trained on huge amounts of text, guessing one word at a time. Follow vivektraces for the next one.
